name: RoboTechnik Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: RoboTechnik Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures automation equipment for photovoltaic, semiconductor, silicon photonics, and precision electronics manufacturing. The company operates through two segments: PV and SiPh Equipment with Related Services, and SiPh Assembly and Testing Equipment with Related Services. The company's PV and SiPh Equipment with Related Services segment manufactures automation equipment for photovoltaic cell production, including production systems for PERC cells, TOPCon cells, and HJT cells.
